import asyncio,json,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts')
from telethon_sessions import DEFAULT_VAULT,inspect
from organic_growth import read_model,ensure_voluntary_request_link,VOLUNTARY_LINK_FILE
from safe_runtime import _connected_client
from operation_policy import load_state
from telethon.tl.functions.messages import GetChatInviteImportersRequest
from telethon.tl.types import InputUserEmpty
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
source=(root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()
assert source=='3d53bf473fc0a37a4d8905f58a5bfff0948b3177'
config=inspect(DEFAULT_VAULT)
model=read_model(DEFAULT_VAULT,config['group'])
assert model and model['approve_join_requests'] is True
p=DEFAULT_VAULT/VOLUNTARY_LINK_FILE
assert p.exists() and not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o600
async def check_account(number):
 c=await _connected_client(config,number)
 try:
  g=await asyncio.wait_for(c.get_entity(config['group']),timeout=20)
  rights=await asyncio.wait_for(c.get_permissions(g,'me'),timeout=20)
  is_admin=bool(getattr(rights,'is_creator',False) or (getattr(rights,'is_admin',False) and getattr(rights,'invite_users',False)))
  return {'number':number,'session_authorized':True,'admin_can_approve':is_admin}
 finally:
  if c.is_connected():await c.disconnect()
async def run():
 for n in (1,2):
  a=await check_account(n)
  assert a['session_authorized'] and a['admin_can_approve']
  print('ADMIN_ACCOUNT',json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
 link=await ensure_voluntary_request_link(config,model,DEFAULT_VAULT,_connected_client)
 assert link['status']=='EXISTING_VERIFIED' and link['created']==0 and link['request_needed'] is True
 print('JOIN_LINK',json.dumps(link,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
 c=await _connected_client(config,1)
 try:
  g=await asyncio.wait_for(c.get_entity(config['group']),timeout=20)
  resp=await asyncio.wait_for(c(GetChatInviteImportersRequest(peer=g,requested=True,offset_date=0,offset_user=InputUserEmpty(),limit=10)),timeout=25)
  pending=getattr(resp,'importers',None)
  assert isinstance(pending,(list,tuple))
  print('READ_ONLY_JOIN_REQUEST_QUEUE',json.dumps({'pending_in_first_page':len(pending),'page_size':10,'approved_in_this_check':0},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
 finally:
  if c.is_connected():await c.disconnect()
asyncio.run(run())
state=load_state(Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json'))
notice_counts={k:sum(isinstance(v,dict) and v.get('owner_notice')==k for v in state['approved_join_requests_done'].values()) for k in ('ACCEPTED','UNCERTAIN','BLOCKED','PENDING')}
print('NOTIFICATION_LEDGER',json.dumps(notice_counts,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print('ACCOUNTS_BLOCKED',sum(bool(a['blocked']) for a in state['accounts'].values()),flush=True)
assert not any(a['blocked'] for a in state['accounts'].values())
print('NOTIFICATION_VERSION_POSTDEPLOY_PASS',flush=True)
PY
